question: Do the fixed Jacobi weight 0.6 and the retained valid/failed physical densities exhibit unstable free-space modes at any smoothed level?
scope: CPU spectral diagnostic only; no GPU rental, solver repair, speedup, V-cycle definiteness proof or novelty result.
operator: Symmetrized independent exact-Q1 element matrices; positive FP64 SIMP material with Emin=1e-6. Fine action matrix-free; coarse matrices independently assembled from all weighted subcells and checked against P^T K_fine P. Fixed coarse entries are projected at their own level, without inserting additional fine support masking into the physical coarse operator.

eigensolver.method: SciPy eigsh largest algebraic, seeded start

acceptance_interpretation: An independently re-evaluated Rayleigh quotient exceeding 2/omega by the declared margin witnesses an unstable Jacobi mode even without eigensolver convergence. A converged maximum-eigenpair estimate below that threshold is not an exact global stability certificate. Neither outcome alone establishes full V-cycle definiteness or GPU failure causality.
local_envelopes: Report normalized 24x24 subcell eigenvalue estimates and row-absolute-sum/diagonal Gershgorin bounds for stored nu .2,.3,.45, levels0..2. These local envelopes do not establish instability of an assembled failed-state operator. No rational/interval certificate is claimed.
previous_goal_turn_classification: Progress: completed numerical replay, local cache audit, one retained infrastructure failure, and GPU pilot retaining six independently verified new state failures. No publication result yet.
